fact: 1949年9月18日，英国宣布英镑贬值30.5%，汇率从1英镑兑4.03美元下调至2.80美元；财政大臣克里普斯（Stafford Cripps）在9月27日下院辩论中确认这一调整。

sources.title: READJUSTMENT OF FOREIGN CURRENCY VALUES (FRASER, Federal Reserve Bulletin)
sources.quote: Devaluation of the pound sterling by 30.5 per cent in terms of the dollar, announced on September 18, 1949, initiated a realignment of foreign exchange values on a scale unprecedented for a short period of time.

sources.title: Sterling Exchange Rate (Hansard, UK Parliament, 27 September 1949)
sources.quote: It was for all these reasons that I have given that we fixed the rate at 2.80 dollars to the pound, that is, a 30 per cent reduction in value of the pound.

fact: 英镑贬值后，到1949年10月18日共有28个国家同步下调本币对美元汇率，包括英镑区国家与多数西欧国家；这是战后布雷顿森林体系首次大规模汇率调整。

sources.title: READJUSTMENT OF FOREIGN CURRENCY VALUES (FRASER)
sources.quote: By October 18, twenty-eight countries adjusted downward the dollar values of their currencies. These included countries in the sterling area and most Western European nations.

sources.title: Sterling Exchange Rate (Hansard, 28 September 1949)
sources.quote: The measure which has given rise to them, namely, the devaluation of the pound sterling from 4.03 down to 2.80 of the American dollar.

fact: 1948年7月5日国民保健署（NHS）成立，向所有英国公民提供免费 GP、牙科与医院治疗；1949年NHS进入运行第二年，与家庭津贴、疾病补助、养老金一起构成从摇篮到坟墓的福利国家体系。

sources.title: History of Clement Attlee (GOV.UK)
sources.quote: As Prime Minister, he enlarged and improved social services and the public sector in post-war Britain, creating the National Health Service and nationalising major industries and public utilities.

sources.title: Attlee's Britain 1945-1951 (The National Archives, UK)
sources.quote: The most significant measure was the creation of the National Health Service in July 1948. In replacing the ramshackle and localised pre-war system of healthcare, and in committing the state to treat people free of charge no matter their condition, the NHS quickly became enshrined as a cornerstone of national life.

fact: 1949年英镑区（Sterling Area）仍为英国与英联邦国家间的结算货币区；英国对美元区持续逆差，1949年9月贬值前面临约8亿英镑的英镑赤字，是被迫贬值的直接原因。

sources.title: Managing the UK economy: Fiscal and monetary policy since 1945 (LSE lecture notes)
sources.quote: Deficit with $ area persists. Debate on devaluation. Gov't decides against. Run on sterling forces devaluation in September. $4.03 -> $2.80 (30.5%). Other countries follow suit.

sources.title: READJUSTMENT OF FOREIGN CURRENCY VALUES (FRASER)
sources.quote: By October 18, twenty-eight countries adjusted downward the dollar values of their currencies. These included countries in the sterling area and most Western European nations.

fact: 1949年英国战后配给（rationing）仍在继续，面包、油脂、肉类、衣物均凭票供应；战时经济的一半产能被转向民用恢复，配给在1954年才完全取消。

sources.title: Social history of the United Kingdom (1945-present) (Kiwix mirror of Wikipedia)
sources.quote: The Treasury, headed by Chancellor of the Exchequer Hugh Dalton, faced urgent problems. Half of the wartime economy had been devoted to mobilisation.

sources.title: Labour Great Britain (1945-1951) (Revision World)
sources.quote: People were now cared for from the cradle to the grave including: Family allowances, Maternity grants, Sickness benefits.

fact: 1945-1951年艾德礼工党政府将煤炭、铁路、电力、煤气、民航、英格兰银行（1946年）等国有化；1949年钢铁工业国有化法案通过，1951年生效；英国产业结构进入”国有化重工业+私人中小企业”双轨。

sources.title: History of Clement Attlee (GOV.UK)
sources.quote: He enlarged and improved social services and the public sector in post-war Britain, creating the National Health Service and nationalising major industries and public utilities.

sources.title: Attlee's Britain 1945-1951 (The National Archives, UK)
sources.quote: The government pursued radical policies elsewhere. Efforts were made to improve education for the mass of the people.

fact: 1949年7月27日，德·哈维兰DH.106彗星（de Havilland Comet）原型机在哈特菲尔德首飞，是世界上第一架加压喷气式客机；1952年5月由英国海外航空（BOAC）投入运营。

sources.title: de Havilland DH.106 Comet 1 and 2 (BAE Systems Heritage)
sources.quote: The first prototype of the Comet, flown on 27th July 1949, demonstrated ground-breaking advancements in flight performance. The Comet was the world's first pressurized commercial jet airliner.

sources.title: de Havilland Comet (Modern Airliners)
sources.quote: First Flight: 27 July 1949. Entered Service: 2 May 1952 (BOAC). Engines: 4 × Rolls-Royce Avon turbojets.
